purpose: Predict whether a multi-decision battery can distinguish trajectory broadcast from node-local LOO credit before any further GPU spend.

prior_result_scope.stage_c2: Integration and replay-equivalence pass; mechanistic-positive gate fail on a saturated, non-discriminating planted-needle task.
prior_result_scope.scientific_conclusion: Stage C2 is not treated as a negative test of the core multi-node credit thesis.

irrelevant_target.prediction: Both estimators have zero mean target gradient; node LOO has zero target-gradient variance while broadcast does not.

redundant_target.prediction: When context already succeeds, the target is locally redundant and node LOO removes its conditional noise.

lucky_target.prediction: Counterfactual branches share luck, so LOO cancels it while trajectory broadcast retains rollout-level noise.

estimator_contract.trajectory_broadcast: All-sample leave-one-out terminal-reward advantage over eight independent two-decision trajectories.
estimator_contract.node_loo: All-branch leave-one-out target advantage over 11 target actions with context and luck held common; eight independent branch episodes averaged per optimizer step.
estimator_contract.target: The exact Bernoulli target-logit policy gradient.
estimator_contract.expected_gradient_rule: Both estimators must match the exact target gradient. The discriminating quantity is variance and finite-budget drift, not mean-gradient disagreement.
estimator_contract.enumeration: Exact multinomial count enumeration; no Monte Carlo for estimator moments.

learning_diagnostic.scope: Seeded tabular nonlinear power diagnostic. Calls-to-threshold is descriptive here and must be independently frozen for a GPU campaign.

mandatory_cpu_gate.decision: Every condition must pass. Otherwise report the CPU failure and do not provision a GPU.

conditional_next_step.if_pass: Write and commit a separate GPU preregistration with nuisance drift, causal calls-to-threshold, a saturation switch, fixed arm order, exact budgets, and earliest-deployed-checkpoint selection before provisioning.
conditional_next_step.if_fail: Stop the credit-confusion campaign without threshold changes.
